messages:
Rae Kim: kicking off a shrink-and-refresh PR for the Quicklaunch quickstart. Goals: present an SDK-first tiny example, promote `redwood login` for auth, add a one-click Web Runner badge, tighten deploy to a single `docker run` line, and fix a stale link to /guides/deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5018
Jonas Müller: Love an SDK-first path. Can we show JS and Python side-by-side with one minimal call each? e.g. `const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY})` and `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))`
Rae Kim: Yep  will show the two-line JS and Python examples and then an "Advanced: env vars & CI" collapsible with the `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and a GitHub Actions snippet.
Isha Patel: Two small asks: 1) add a short blurb about model alias rename (`helium-v1` -> `helium`) with a sed/perl two-liner for repo migration; 2) replace `node:18` Docker base with `node:18-slim` and include an Alpine variant for strict distro shops.
Rae Kim: Done. Migration helpers included: `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g'` and a macOS-safe `git grep -l "helium-v1" | xargs perl -pi -e 's/helium-v1/helium/g'`. Docker now uses `node:18-slim` as default, Alpine variant appended.
Cam (Docs): UX note: make the Web Runner badge optional and clearly marked "One-click (for demo)" so users don't think it's production. Also the quickstart previously said "no rate limits" which is wrong  change to "soft limits on free tier; see pricing"
docs-preview-bot: Lint check failed for PR 5018: broken link detected at /quicklaunch/#deploy -> 404.
Rae Kim: Thanks bot  fixed the anchor and updated the link to /learn/deploy/quicklaunch. Also added a tiny paragraph on token scoping (user vs org token) since people often hit cross-account 403s.
Jonas Müller: Suggest adding a short Terraform snippet for infra folks who want to provision a minimal container; two lines max. Keeps the page friendly to infra teams.
Rae Kim: Added an optional "Infrastructure: Terraform" callout with a one-block minimal `aws_ecs_task_definition` example and note that it's optional. Kept it collapsed by default.
Isha Patel: Can we include a troubleshooting curl command for auth checks? Eg `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` and mention clock skew/expired keys.
Rae Kim: Added the curl check and a short FAQ entry: "If you get 401, check token scope and system clock."
docs-preview-bot: Preview build queued for PR 5018 (preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quicklaunch/preview).
Cam (Docs): Quick style nits: 1) change the H3 in the deploy section to H2 for accessibility; 2) reword "one-click" to "demo one-click".
Rae Kim: Addressed both nits and pushed the fix. Running a local link check before merging.
docs-preview-bot: Preview build passed for PR 5018 2705 (staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/quicklaunch/preview)
Jonas Müller: Reviewed and approved. Thanks for keeping the page lean, should reduce confusion for new signups.
Rae Kim: Great  plan to merge in the next docs deploy window. Will follow up if any post-merge fixes come up. :shipit:
